Let $u=\log_{2}\left(x\right).$ Differentiating, we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{1}{x \ln{\left(2 \right)}}\,\Longrightarrow\,\ln{\left(2 \right)}\,\text{d}u=\frac{\text{d}x}{x}.
$$

Using the above, we can write the integral in terms of $u$ and evaluate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{\log_{2}\left(x\right)}{x}\,\text{d}x & =1\int \log_{2}\left(x\right)\cdot\frac{\text{d}x}{x} \\  & =1\int u\cdot \ln{\left(2 \right)}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\ln{\left(2 \right)}\int u\,\text{d}u \\  & =\ln{\left(2 \right)}\cdot \frac{u^{2}}{2}+C \\  & =\frac{\ln{\left(2 \right)} (\log_{2}\left(x\right))^{2}}{2}+C\end{aligned}
$$
